tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Dissimilar electrode
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office YTPS Raichur

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
PLEASE REFER FOR ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER ATTACHED TENDER DOCUMENT.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have successfully supplied Welding electrodes to any Govt. Sector/Major PSU/Power plants/Private sector/any industryamounting to Rs.7.12 lakh or above in the preceding five years from the date of tender notification. In proof of the same, bidder shallupload supportive documents (Purchase orders/supply orders limited to two numbers), issued by competent authority.

The bidder shall be a Manufacturer/Authorized dealer/supplier of Welding electrodes. As documentary proof, bidder shall uploadManufacturer certificate/ Authorization certificates/ supplied PO invoices/relevant documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Manufacturer/Authorized dealer certificate/supplied PO invoices/relevant documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs. 14.25 lakh or above in at least two financial years inthe preceding five financial years i.e., (2021-22 to 2025-26). As a proof, bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss.Statement duly certified by a chartered accountant.
